title: Greek New Testament (27 books; SBLGNT)
edition_reference: SBLGNT (Society of Biblical Literature Greek New Testament)
constitutional_role: Full 27-book Greek New Testament corpus. Per Lee adjudication 2026-06-28, transforms work from the original Greek. Revelation has its own M1 canon-star (under Feist's Polaris office; Revelation First's argument places it as the earliest NT composition); the four Gospels are at Polaris-cluster M1/M2 stars as companions to Revelation.
